title: 第七章 历史分叉楔子第八章 赞拜不名
lines: 江河文明的个体有一个共性。
那就是喜欢倒查历史。
可能是历史上有太多的波澜壮阔和意难平，也可能是历代史官的存在养出这个奢侈的爱好。
假如以某个不能直说的历史为准则，那么大曜朝所在的这个世界的历史分叉在哪呢？
在三国。
章武元年，帝即帝位，国号汉，改元章武，史称季汉，以续汉祚。是年，吴侯孙权背盟，袭杀关羽，取荆州，帝震怒，亲率大军伐吴，兵发秭归，誓为云长报仇，亦图复荆州、固基业。
吴遣陆逊为大都督，领兵拒战，坚壁清野，欲拖疲汉军。帝久攻不下，军屯夷陵，陆逊遂引火攻，帝察其计，令军士预制防火器具，外设伏兵，待吴军来攻，内外夹击，火攻反为汉军所用。
夷陵一场大火未能烧散昭烈帝的梦，反而是烧出了汉烈祖昭文皇帝的三造大汉！
没有夷陵之战的国之精锐尽毁。
季汉的本钱顿时雄厚起来。
随后是建兴五年武侯亮六出祁山，屡破魏军，收复陇右、关中之地，兵锋直指洛阳。
前有高祖开基，光武中兴，今有昭文复荆州、武侯平中原，三兴汉室，功盖千秋。
季汉国运三百五十一载。
也是一个强亡的主，把周边匈奴、鲜卑、羌、氐和南越都扫了一遍，特别是西域那块实质性强行进了吞并填边。
但祸因也因此留下。
过于武德充沛的季汉对西域诸国没有半点怀柔，让西域成为了季汉的出血口。
结果因为过于正确无人敢反对硬生生把自己玩崩了，西域这块丢了。
再朝后是一个国号为宁的短命朝代登场。
不过两年半就被一个刘姓子给推翻了。
接着是长达四十年的中原乱战。
汉的天命过于耀目正统。
以至于此后不管任何一个自认正统的政权都将收复西域视为己任。
‘跳出历史和民族情绪旁观，收复西域对于封建王朝有着实质性的好处，季汉的国策在西域留下大量同文同种，国朝认可，民风彪悍的人力资源……’
左墟拍了拍脑袋，把耳朵里的水和莫名其妙的信息一同拍了出去。
什么叫跳出。
他就不跳出？圣天子看的正嗨呢！
败兴致的东西，等抓到你就诛你九族！
大概是圣天子左墟的慈父般的关爱有了效果，接下来那信息倒是没有再冒出来了。
四十年乱战后是前朝大朔。
看国号就知道隐患了。
西征和北定两军和庞大的疆域制造出了两个中心。
用左墟的话来概括就是：西征一直猛攻，北定逼逼赖赖。
西征那波猛男一看你麻痹打的那么拉胯还敢哔哔？干死你丫的！
所以今天在大曜朝。
能够看见许多眼发非玄的国民。
看完了历史，作为皇帝左墟算是明白了大曜目前的疑难杂症在什么地方了。
大曜目前有三个经济圈。
一个西域，一个北苍，一个南方沿海。
陈椎这个丞相以前是在三个鸡蛋上跳舞，他的声望和手段可以调和大曜的这个矛盾，这个让人头疼的矛盾很快就要轮到左墟来面对了。
不过狗皇帝兼暴君左墟不是人，他是圣天子，是神皇！
眺望到未来的他没有头疼，反而是迫不及待！
左墟一直有一种猛兽般的直觉。
content_en:
The individuals of the river civilization have one thing in common.
That is, I like to look back at history.
It may be that there are too many ups and downs in history, or it may be that the existence of historians throughout the ages has fostered this extravagant hobby.
If a certain history that cannot be explained directly is used as the criterion, then where does the history of the world where the Great Yao Dynasty is located diverge?
In the Three Kingdoms.
In the first year of Zhangwu, the emperor ascended the throne, and the country's name was Han. It was changed to Zhangwu in the Yuan Dynasty and was called Jihan in history to continue Han Zuo. That year, Wu Hou Sun Quan betrayed the alliance, attacked and killed Guan Yu, and captured Jingzhou. The emperor was furious and personally led a large army to attack Wu. The soldiers returned to Zi, vowing to avenge Yunchang, and also to restore Jingzhou and consolidate their foundation.
Wu sent Lu Xun as the chief governor, led the troops to resist the war, strengthened the walls and cleared the country, in order to wear down the Han army. The emperor was unable to attack for a long time, and the army garrisoned Yiling. Lu Xun then launched a fire attack. The emperor observed his plan and ordered his sergeants to prepare fire-proof equipment and set up an ambush outside, waiting for the Wu army to attack. They attacked from inside and outside, but the fire attack was used by the Han army.
A fire in Yiling failed to dispel the dream of Emperor Zhaolie, but instead burned out the three great men of Emperor Zhaowen, the ancestor of the Han Dynasty!
Without the Battle of Yiling, the country's elite would have been completely destroyed.
Ji Han's capital suddenly became stronger.
Then in the fifth year of Jianxing, Wuhou Liang Liu came out of Qishan, defeated the Wei army repeatedly, regained the land of Longyou and Guanzhong, and directed his troops towards Luoyang.
In the past, Gao Zu founded the foundation and Guangwu revitalized the country. Today, Zhaowen restored Jingzhou and Wuhou leveled the Central Plains, revitalizing the Han Dynasty three times and making great contributions to the future.
Ji Han's national destiny lasted three hundred and fifty-one years.
He was also a master of forced subjugation. He swept through the surrounding Xiongnu, Xianbei, Qiang, Di and South Vietnam, especially the Western Region, which was essentially forcibly annexed and filled in.
But the cause of the disaster also remains.
Ji Han, who was too martial and virtuous, had no mercy for the countries in the Western Regions, making the Western Regions a bleeding mouth for Ji Han.
As a result, because he was too correct and no one dared to object, he was defeated and the Western Region was lost.
After the dynasty, a short-lived dynasty named Ning appeared.
However, he was overthrown by a man named Liu in two and a half years.
What followed was forty years of chaos in the Central Plains.
Han's destiny was too dazzling and orthodox.
So that from then on, any regime that considered itself orthodox would regard the recovery of the Western Region as its own responsibility.
'Looking beyond history and national sentiments, recovering the Western Regions has substantial benefits for the feudal dynasty. Ji Han's national policy left a large number of human resources in the Western Regions with the same culture and species, recognized by the country and the dynasty, and strong folk customs...'
Zuo Xu patted his head and wiped out the water in his ears along with the inexplicable message.
What is jumping out?
He won't jump out? The Holy Emperor was looking very happy!
If you are a spoiler of interest, I will kill all nine of your tribes when I catch you!
Probably because the fatherly care of the Holy Emperor Zuoxu had an effect, the message did not appear again.
After forty years of chaos, it was the Great Shuo of the previous dynasty.
You will know the hidden dangers just by looking at the country number.
The two armies of the Western Expedition and Beiding and the huge territory created two centers.
To sum it up in Zuo Xu's words: The Western Expedition has been attacking fiercely, and Beiding has been pressing hard.
When those tough guys from the Western Expedition saw you so paralyzed and hit you so hard, how dare you beep? Fuck you to death!
So today in Dayao Dynasty.
You can see many people who are very eccentric.
After reading the history, as the emperor Zuoxu, he finally understood where Dayao's current incurable disease lies.
Dayao currently has three economic circles.
One is the Western Region, one is Beicang, and the other is the southern coast.
Chen Zhui, the prime minister, used to dance on three eggs. His reputation and means can reconcile this contradiction in Da Yao. It will soon be Zuo Xu's turn to face this troublesome contradiction.
But the dog emperor and tyrant Zuo Xu is not a human being, he is the Holy Emperor, the God Emperor!
Looking at the future, he didn't have a headache, but couldn't wait!
Zuo Xu has always had a beast-like intuition.
